description: SportsLine (CBS Sports) odds board: for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college or WNBA, every listed game with teams, start time, venue, TV, status, SportsLine's projected score and, per sportsbook (consensus, BetMGM, DraftKings, FanDuel, bet365, Caesars…), the opening and current moneyline, point spread and total with prices. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_espn_standings when you need ESPN standings for NBA, NFL, MLB or NHL, by conference; sports_fanduel when you need FanDuel Sportsbook game lines for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
